definitions.explanation: Intense physical or mental suffering — writhing in pain, or being torn by inner torment. A literary, fairly heavy word, common in novels, news reports, and medical descriptions.

examples.japanese: {苦悶|くもん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浮|う}かべる→浮かべる：13314_ukaberu⟧。
examples.english: To show a look of agony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦{腹痛|ふくつう}→腹痛：05019_fukutsuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{苦悶|くもん}⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The patient was writhing in agony from severe stomach pain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{苦悶|くもん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{解放|かいほう}→解放：00135_kaihou⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧、ようやく⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧な{気持|きも}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なれ→なる：01970_naru⟧た。
examples.english: Released from years of inner anguish, I was finally able to feel at peace.

notes:
Compound of {苦|く} (suffering) + {悶|もん} (writhing in pain). Used as a noun and as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb ({苦悶|くもん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). Implies severe, ongoing torment — not minor discomfort.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {苦悶|くもん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧: a look of agony
- {苦悶|くもん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちた→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: a voice full of anguish
- {苦悶|くもん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to writhe/agonize
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{苦悶|くもん}: inner anguish
- {苦悶|くもん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧: after great anguish

REGISTER:
Literary and heavy in tone. In casual speech, use ⟦{苦|くる}しむ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧ or ⟦{悩|なや}む→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧ instead.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{苦痛|くつう}→苦痛：02652_kutsuu⟧: pain; suffering — broader, can be mild or severe
- ⟦{苦悩|くのう}→苦悩：05517_kunou⟧: anguish; distress — emphasizes the mental/emotional side
- ⟦{懊悩|おうのう}→懊悩：09462_ounou⟧: deep mental anguish — even more literary
